<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-screen-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDetails" name="Phone model and damage details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ItemLists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InstructionRequest" name="Request for repair instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairInstructions" name="Repair instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendContact" name="Request to borrow or buy items"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Review" name="Repair review"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairVideo" name="Repair video"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneForExpert" name="Phone sent for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="Phone owner" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Tool" name="Online repair tool" processRef="Process_Tool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Expert"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairDetails" name="Phone model and damage details"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Start_ToolRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ItemLists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLists" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"
                      messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendContact" name="Contact friends"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InstructionRequest" name="Request repair instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_RequestInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructionRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_InstructionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairInstructions" name="Repair instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Review" name="Send review"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_Tool"
                      messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairVideo" name="Send repair video"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_Tool"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneForExpert" name="Send phone to expert"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"
                      messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="DIY repair of a broken smartphone screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_User" name="Start repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken"
                   messageRef="Message_RepairDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                      messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckOwnedItems" name="Check which items are already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about items?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends to borrow or buy items"
                   messageRef="Message_FriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeFriendChoice" name="Continue sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy remaining items"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestInstructions" name="Request repair instructions"
                   messageRef="Message_InstructionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Repair the phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairWorked" name="Did the repair work?"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Choose review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review" messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Finish sending feedback"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairComplete" name="Repair worked and feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Expert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_01" sourceRef="Start_User" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${contactFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeFriendChoice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${not contactFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_07" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeFriendChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_08" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeFriendChoice" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_09" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_RequestInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_10" sourceRef="Task_RequestInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_12" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_13" name="Worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_14" name="Did not work" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${not repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_15" name="Review selected" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${sendReview}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_16" name="Video selected" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${sendVideo}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_17" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_18" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_19" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="End_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_User_20" sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="End_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Tool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ToolRequest" name="Receive phone model and damage details">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ToolRequest" messageRef="Message_RepairDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareLists" name="Prepare materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                   messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructionRequest" name="Receive request for repair instructions"
                      messageRef="Message_InstructionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareInstructions" name="Prepare repair instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions"
                   messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Tool" name="Instructions provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_01" sourceRef="Start_ToolRequest" targetRef="Task_PrepareLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_02" sourceRef="Task_PrepareLists" targetRef="Task_SendLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_03" sourceRef="Task_SendLists" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructionRequest" targetRef="Task_PrepareInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_05" sourceRef="Task_PrepareInstructions" targetRef="Task_SendInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_06" sourceRef="Task_SendInstructions" targetRef="End_Tool"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ItemLists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices for each part"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneForExpert" name="Phone for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RepairTool" name="Online repair tool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>

                      sourceRef="Participant_RepairTool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsContact" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsContact"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Review" name="Send review"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_RepairTool"
                      messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairVideo" name="Send repair video"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_RepairTool"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneForExpert" name="Send phone to expert"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"
                      messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PhoneOwner" name="DIY repair of a broken smartphone screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Start DIY repair"/>

                   messageRef="Message_RepairDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                      messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckOwnedItems" name="Check which materials and tools are already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsOffer" name="Can friends provide items to borrow or buy cheaply?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends to borrow or buy items cheaply"
                   messageRef="Message_FriendsContact"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeSourcing" name="Continue sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy the rest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive instructions for fixing the phone"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix the phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Send a review and/or repair video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review" messageRef="Message_Review"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Finish sending feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert"
                   messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairWorked" name="Repair worked and feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ExpertRepair" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friendsCanProvideItemsCheaply}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSourcing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSourcing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeSourcing" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Review selected" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="End_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="End_ExpertRepair"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-screen-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneModel" name="Phone model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BrokenPart" name="What is broken"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ItemLists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairInstructions" name="Repair instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsContact" name="Request to borrow or buy items cheaply"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Review" name="Repair review"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairVideo" name="Video of the repair"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneForExpert" name="Phone for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PhoneOwner" name="Phone owner" processRef="Process_PhoneOwner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RepairTool" name="Online repair tool" processRef="Process_RepairTool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Expert"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneModel" name="Enter phone model"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Start_Tool"
                      messageRef="Message_PhoneModel"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BrokenPart" name="Describe what is broken"
                      sourceRef="Task_DescribeDamage" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDamage"
                      messageRef="Message_BrokenPart"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ItemLists" name="Provide lists and ordering choices"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideLists" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"
                      messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsContact" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsContact"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Review" name="Send a review"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_RepairTool"
                      messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairVideo" name="Send a repair video"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_RepairTool"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneForExpert" name="Send phone to an expert"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"
                      messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PhoneOwner" name="DIY repair of a broken smartphone screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Start DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EnterModel" name="Enter phone model" messageRef="Message_PhoneModel"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DescribeDamage" name="Describe what is broken" messageRef="Message_BrokenPart"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckOwnedItems" name="Check what materials and tools are already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsOption" name="Can items be borrowed or bought cheaply from friends?" default="Flow_FriendsNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends to borrow or buy items cheaply" messageRef="Message_FriendsContact"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SourcingMerge" name="Continue sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy the rest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive instructions for fixing the phone" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix the phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?" default="Flow_RepairFailed"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Send a review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review" messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Finish sending feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert" messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairWorked" name="Repair worked and feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ExpertRepair" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_01" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Task_DescribeDamage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_03" sourceRef="Task_DescribeDamage" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_05" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsOption"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOption" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsAvailableFromFriends}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOption" targetRef="Gateway_SourcingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_SourcingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToBuy" sourceRef="Gateway_SourcingMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_10" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_12" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairWorked" name="Worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="Did not work" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackReview" name="Send review" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendReview}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackVideo" name="Send video" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendVideo}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="End_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="End_ExpertRepair"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RepairTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Tool" name="Receive phone model">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PhoneModel" messageRef="Message_PhoneModel"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDamage" name="Receive what is broken" messageRef="Message_BrokenPart"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_02" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDamage" targetRef="Task_ProvideLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_03" sourceRef="Task_ProvideLists" targetRef="Task_ProvideInstructions"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-screen-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneModel" name="Phone model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Damage" name="What is broken"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ItemLists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices for each part"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairInstructions" name="Instructions for fixing the phone"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsContact" name="Request to borrow or buy items cheaply"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Review" name="Repair review"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairVideo" name="Video of the repair"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneForExpert" name="Phone for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PhoneOwner" name="Phone owner" processRef="Process_PhoneOwner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RepairTool" name="Online repair tool" processRef="Process_RepairTool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Expert"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneModel" name="Enter phone model"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Start_ToolModel"
                      messageRef="Message_PhoneModel"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Damage" name="Enter what is broken"
                      sourceRef="Task_EnterDamage" targetRef="Task_ToolReceiveDamage"
                      messageRef="Message_Damage"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ItemLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                      sourceRef="Task_PresentLists" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"
                      messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_PresentInstructions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendsContact" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_FriendsContact"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Review" name="Send review"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_RepairTool"
                      messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairVideo" name="Send repair video"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_RepairTool"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneForExpert" name="Send phone to expert"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"
                      messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PhoneOwner" name="DIY repair of a broken smartphone screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Start DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EnterModel" name="Enter phone model" messageRef="Message_PhoneModel"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EnterDamage" name="Enter what is broken" messageRef="Message_Damage"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                      messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckOwnedItems" name="Check which materials and tools are already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsOffer" name="Can items be borrowed or bought cheaply from friends?"
                           default="Flow_FriendsNo"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends to borrow or buy items cheaply"
                   messageRef="Message_FriendsContact"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeSourcing" name="Continue sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy the rest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive instructions for fixing the phone"
                      messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Fix the phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?" default="Flow_RepairFailed"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" name="Send a review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review" messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" name="Finish sending feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert"
                   messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairWorked" name="Repair worked and feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ExpertRepair" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_01" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Task_EnterDamage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_03" sourceRef="Task_EnterDamage" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_05" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friendsCanProvideItemsCheaply}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSourcing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsContacted" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeSourcing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToBuyRest" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeSourcing" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInstructions" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRepair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairWorked" name="Worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairWorked}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="Did not work" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseReview" name="Review selected" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendReview}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseVideo" name="Video selected" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendVideo}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewDone" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoDone" sourceRef="Task_SendVideo" targetRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="End_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToExpertEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="End_ExpertRepair"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RepairTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ToolModel" name="Receive phone model">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ToolModel" messageRef="Message_PhoneModel"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ToolReceiveDamage" name="Receive what is broken" messageRef="Message_Damage"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices"
                   messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone"
                   messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Tool" name="Information provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_01" sourceRef="Start_ToolModel" targetRef="Task_ToolReceiveDamage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_02" sourceRef="Task_ToolReceiveDamage" targetRef="Task_PresentLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_03" sourceRef="Task_PresentLists" targetRef="Task_PresentInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_04" sourceRef="Task_PresentInstructions" targetRef="End_Tool"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description establishes an order between activities or between an activity and a decision: Model the stated process steps and connect them with sequence flows in that order, including transitions to and from decision gateways.
rules.situation: the description establishes an order between activities or between an activity and a decision

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or decision in terms of a specific action, object, or outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves that meaning; do not replace it with a broader stage name or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description says a participant provides multiple distinct inputs that determine later system-provided outputs: Model a separate activity for each input before the system produces those outputs.
rules.situation: the description says a participant provides multiple distinct inputs that determine later system-provided outputs

rules.instruction: When the description says that a digital system supplies information to a user: model the system's act of presenting that information as an activity, rather than modeling the user's receipt of it or an unstated preparatory action.
rules.situation: the description says that a digital system supplies information to a user

rules.instruction: When the description says that a procedure is carried out after receiving directions and later distinguishes outcomes by whether it succeeds: Model the procedure as a distinct activity after the directions are received and before the outcome decision, preserving that order with sequence flows.
rules.situation: the description says that a procedure is carried out after receiving directions and later distinguishes outcomes by whether it succeeds
